sentences.en: His heart was weak and he needed constant medical supervision.
sentences.zh: 他的心脏较弱，需要持续的医疗监督。

sentences.en: Under supervision, he looks after his clients much better.
sentences.zh: 在监督下，他对客户的照顾更好了。

sentences.en: Students don't always learn effectively without constant supervision.
sentences.zh: 没有持续的监督，学生们未必能有效学习。

senses.zh: 监督,管理,监督的行为、过程或作用
